estimationGuidance.ambiguous: Report ambiguous-as-false-positive and ambiguous-as-true-positive bounds, plus an explicit non-ambiguous rate.
estimationGuidance.confidenceIntervals: Do not use pooled Clopper-Pearson, Wilson, or Wald intervals over route rows. Use a stratified cluster bootstrap over selected family-pattern cells, with zero cell-selection variance for full-census strata.
estimationGuidance.deleteOperationResource: Report with the DELETE audit taxonomy by bucket, including linked and unlinked cells. Map cancellation labels into operation cancellation only after adjudication.
estimationGuidance.strictCancellation: Compute per-pattern rates and a pattern-family weighted estimate using populationFamilyMemberships. This estimates pattern-family membership precision, not unique-family prevalence over 407 families.
estimationGuidance.strictFamilySensitivity: strictFamilyApproxInclusionProbability gives a collapse-to-family sensitivity check using 1 - product(1 - patternSamplingFraction). Treat it as exploratory because bucket quotas and repository caps make the exact design probability more complex.

selectionProvenance.evidenceId: sha256(route_id, commit, pattern, sourceKind, path, file, lineStart, symbol)
selectionProvenance.familyPatternRepresentative: Uniform pseudo-random route selection within each family_id x pattern cell after stable identity sorting. Automated linkage, HTTP 202 responses, source kind, and confidence are not used as preferential keys.
